name: Thela Stock Manager
changelog: v4.0.0: POS Cockpit, On-Screen Keypad & Deluxe Haptics Suite: (1) Dual-Cockpit Glance Header with Active Bag Stock and live Today's Activity Pulse (OUT, IN, entries), (2) Integrated On-Screen Numeric Keypad (0-9, clear, backspace, +25, +50, +100, done) eliminating mobile OS keyboard popups, (3) Prominent Selected Quantity Cockpit Badge with custom keypad toggle, (4) Deluxe Haptic Feedback Suite (12ms subtle clicks, chord success pulses, warning buzzes), (5) Smart Party Note with 1-tap clear button (✕) and active chip highlighting, (6) Pulsating neon halos and spring dynamics for immediate physical tactile feedback.
